default_agent_rule: Start with the governed snapshot. Load scoped generated slices only when the coding task matches load_when.
full_snapshot_rule: Do not load the full architecture-analysis.snapshot.json by default. Prefer the scoped files under agent-docs/machine/architecture/.

project.purpose: Project/repository inventory and top-level architecture graph
load_when: package metadata, dependency declarations, repository layout, or broad architecture overview changes
dependency/refactor tasks need a compact project inventory
release preparation needs a generated static baseline

entrypoints.purpose: CLI/package entrypoints, Control Center/daemon/doctor startup and FL controller lifecycle
load_when: console script, package entrypoint, daemon, status, doctor, or Control Center startup behavior changes
FL controller script lifecycle entrypoints change
packaging or installer work needs externally visible command mapping

mcp_surface.purpose: MCP tools, resources, prompts and public tool safety summary
load_when: MCP tools, resources, or prompts are added, removed, renamed, or changed
public MCP behavior, safety annotations, or tool registration changes
FastMCP registration baseline or prompt/resource packaging changes

runtime.purpose: Runtime host, daemon RPC, report store and workflow execution state
load_when: daemon, RuntimeCore, runtime RPC, report store, or workflow execution changes
bridge/session runtime ownership, freshness, invalidation, or observation state changes
Control Center talks to daemon/runtime APIs differently

controller_surface.purpose: Protocol commands, controller handlers and SysEx bridge boundary
load_when: protocol commands, wire format, MIDI SysEx payload, or controller handlers change
bridge/controller command mapping or pagination behavior changes
FL controller script exposes new handler capability or removes one

operation_registry.purpose: Declarative operations, safety classes, readback/snapshot/restore metadata
load_when: operation registry entries, command mapping, snapshot/readback/restore builder, or batch eligibility change
persistent write path changes or new reversible operation is introduced
safety class assignment is added, removed, or changed

analysis_workflows.purpose: Workflow registry, reports, evidence, scoring, freshness and Control Center panels
load_when: workflow registry, report schema, scoring, evidence, freshness, prerequisites, or health aggregation changes
Control Center project-review workflow panel ownership or endpoint changes
analysis depth levels, audio analysis prerequisites, or report confidence semantics change

safety_trust.purpose: Safety model, forbidden capabilities and trust boundaries
load_when: safety classes, approval gates, rollback, readback, persistent write contract, or forbidden/manual-only capability changes
trust boundary changes across MCP, daemon, bridge, MIDI, generated scripts, FL controller, or user-provided files
security/safety audit work needs the generated risk baseline

data_state.purpose: Knowledgebase, packaged context, templates and state/data locations
load_when: knowledgebase, packaged MCP context docs/prompts, report storage, templates, audio/export scratch paths, or project state paths change
data ownership, cache, state invalidation, or source-of-truth changes

import_graph.purpose: Top import graph and observed external dependencies
load_when: dependency direction, module extraction, package split, import-cycle, or large refactor tasks
developer needs a generated dependency overview before changing module boundaries

quality_observations.purpose: Quality observations and notable risk findings
load_when: architecture audit, senior review, release readiness, or drift check tasks
quality/risk findings are being triaged or converted into issues

mcp_tool_modules.purpose: Module-specific generated inventories for MCP tool changes; load only the affected tool module slice.
load_when: a coding task touches one concrete tool module under src/fls_pilot/tools/
MCP safety/doc annotations need review for a specific tool module
full MCP surface audit needs all module slices

mcp_tool_or_prompt_change: agent-docs/machine/architecture/mcp-tools/<affected-module>.snapshot.json when a specific tool module changes

update_rule: After coding changes, update only the affected scoped generated snapshot slices when generated architecture facts changed.
Update architecture-governance.snapshot.json only when governed facts changed.
If no governed or generated architecture facts changed, state this explicitly in the handoff or PR.
Regenerate the full static analysis and all slices before beta/stable releases or after broad architecture refactors.
